_description: ISCA'27 P20: m3p + page migration counter unit 4 KB, target class (local,net); pm defaults (sw 5 us, shootdown 1 us, threshold 256, batch 256, cooldown 5 us, max 3 migrations). class: dom-share 0.6, median-max-readers 31, broadcast-k 4 (k0 = broadcast pages stay), min-saving 0.1. local = also count the owner's own L1V misses; net = do not count accesses served by an M3 replica. See isca27/prompts/P20_placement_m3.md.
